data.title: UPDATE: Disposition production REVIEW-DEFENSE comments (stale removal + verification)

content.text: **What**: Run audit-review-defenses.sh against plugins/dso/scripts/, plugins/dso/hooks/, plugins/dso/skills/, plugins/dso/agents/ (excluding test files).
**Why**: SC-2 requires every production REVIEW-DEFENSE verified — defended pattern still exists, referenced artifact present, ticket deferrals checked.
**Scope**: For each: (a) still-defended → leave intact, (b) stale → delete, (c) deferral-complete → delete, (d) needs-followon-check → defer to task-8.
- Every production REVIEW-DEFENSE classified stale or deferral-complete is removed
- Every still-defended REVIEW-DEFENSE is left untouched and logged
- Re-running audit-review-defenses.sh against production plugin files shows zero stale/deferral-complete defenses remaining
- docs/findings/epic-5018-64ce-todo-sweep.md REVIEW-DEFENSE section has one row per finding
- Safeguard files (pre-commit hooks, review-gate.sh, test-gate scripts): if stale REVIEW-DEFENSE detected, escalate to user per rule:no-safeguard-edits — do NOT auto-remove
